items.html:
Tamauri Tucker, a right-hand lower middle-order batsman and offspinner, has been playing cricket since 1999 and made his first-class debut in the Intercontinental Cup in 2007. Tucker is part of Bermuda's squad for the Under-19 World Cup in 2008 and played a significant role in his team's qualifying campaign. He was the leading wicket-taker in the Americas U-19 qualifier, with ten wickets which included a haul of 6 for 9 against Bahamas.
Cricinfo staff February 2008

stories.subTitle: BCB increase help to players
